ledger.claim: No deviation is established: the POL-RD-01 gate is not cleared. The governing distance is the trace, and the trace is IMPAIRED — weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE — which I disclose at the outset. Measured the way POL-RD-07(i) prescribes as the reading most favourable to the driver, the straight line between the bounding fixes across the 428 s dropout, the trip is 21.20 km against a booked optimal of 18.4 km — an excess of 2.8 km, or 15.22% of optimal. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to exceed BOTH 20% of optimal AND 0.8 km. The percentage limb fails, so no route deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip, billing integrity under POL-RD-09(4) being the only carve-out and being absent here.

The trip record offers the rider no second, unimpaired measurement. Its actual_distance_km of 21.2 is, by the admissibility note, itself derived from the same impaired trace and so adds no independent evidence of distance; POL-RD-01 in any event makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km govern where it disagrees with trip_record.actual_distance_km, and forbids citing the rounded convenience copy for the threshold test. The trace relied on is impaired: EV-GPS-00110, weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is not discharged. He must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold measured from an unimpaired gps_trace, or from an independent source of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names. He has neither: the only trace is impaired (EV-GPS-00110, weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE); the fare ledger merely repeats the trace figure (EV-FARE-00110, weight 0.75, PARTIAL_RECORD); the trip record's distance is a copy of the trace; and no gantry record places the vehicle off the optimal corridor. The rider's own account adds nothing, by his own admission he was not watching the route.

The billed distance is not the independent corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) demands. The fare breakdown's distance_charged_km of 21.20 is identical to the trace figure, and POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes a billed distance that is a copy of the trace from the list of independent sources. Both artifacts are impaired and I disclose both: the fare breakdown at weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD (erp_gantries null against a non-zero toll); the trace at weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE. The ledger corroborates neither a longer route nor an off-corridor gantry.

The contemporaneous record is consistent with the optimal corridor, not a detour. The driver messaged the rider 'going KPE ah boss' before entering the tunnel and the rider replied 'ok'; the KPE is exactly the corridor the platform's own route uses, the trip record recording the optimal as KPE then ECP and crossing both gantries. The chat log is IMPAIRED — weight 0.6, issue TRUNCATED_LOG — which I disclose; what survives is nonetheless the only contemporaneous account of the route, and it sits with the pro-driver tunnel reading rather than with a surface detour.

The rider's $3.00 ERP objection yields no billing-integrity refund. The fare breakdown carries no erp_gantry lines at all, so no gantry can be shown to be one the trace never passes; the optimal route's own ERP is 3.00 and the ledger's tolls_erp is 3.00, so the line matches the platform's own estimate rather than a phantom charge. The ledger is IMPAIRED — weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD — which I disclose. POL-RD-09(4) requires an unmatched line before anything is refunded, and where a gantry carries no coordinates the line is treated as matched.

Even if some deviation were found, it is not MATERIAL and no repeat-pattern uplift could attach. At 15.22% the excess is far below POL-RD-01's 50% materiality limb and below its 8.0 km limb, so POL-RD-06 is not engaged. For completeness the citable counters show no pattern in any event: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 744, so neither POL-RD-06 limb is met and no FULL_REFUND uplift or conduct referral can follow. The trace (EV-GPS-00110) is impaired at weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, which I disclose.

No traffic advisory covers the KPE or the ECP in the trip window, and the driver needs none. EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0, so the absence is itself citable; no party has cited an advisory, and the driver advances no closure or external cause for a detour — he explains the tunnel dropout, not a diversion. With no advisory on file there is no external event that could have pushed the vehicle off the optimal corridor, and POL-RD-03 exoneration is unavailable to either side; an uncited traffic excuse carries no weight under POL-RD-13. The trace is impaired (EV-GPS-00110, weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE), which I disclose.

ledger.claim: On no view of this record does the rider recover the $10.00 he seeks. NO_ACTION is party-relative under POL-GEN-03: with the rider as filer, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0, NO_ACTION leaves the present charge standing, which is the driver's position. If the impaired trace is instead treated as precluding a final finding, the deciding distance fact is carried solely by EV-GPS-00110 at weight 0.39, so POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-07(iii) together with POL-RD-10(3) makes the terminal outcome ESCALATE — which holds the disputed amount rather than collecting or refunding it. Either disposition leaves the driver's fare intact and returns nothing to the rider. The trace and the fare ledger are both impaired and I disclose them: EV-GPS-00110 weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE; EV-FARE-00110 weight 0.75, PARTIAL_RECORD.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver. This case cannot be decided on the record, so it goes to a human reviewer and no money moves in the meantime. The disputed SGD 10.00 is held, not refunded and not collected.

The figures. The trip of 22 July 2026 ran from Compass One, Sengkang, to Marina Bay Financial Centre. The platform's optimal route for the booking is 18.4 km and 26 minutes (KPE then ECP). The trip was billed at 21.2 km and 39 minutes, total SGD 34.42: base fare 3.80, distance 15.90, time 10.92, ERP 3.00 and platform fee 0.80. The excess over optimal is 2.8 km, or 15.22%. POL-RD-01's gate needs an excess over both 20% of optimal (3.68 km) and 0.8 km. On those figures the gate is not cleared.

Why that does not decide it. The governing distance is the GPS trace, and EV-GPS-00110 is impaired. It carries a 428.0-second gap between 18:35:00 and 18:42:08, bounded by the Defu Flyover and Kallang portal fixes 6.9 km apart, and the gap covers the entire stretch the rider disputes, through the KPE tunnel. That is over POL-RD-07's own 90-second limb, so the trace is impaired for policy and not merely for the schema pre-pass: weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage 81.7%, below 90.0). POL-RD-07(i) makes me read the gap as the straight line between the bounding fixes - the reading most favourable to the driver - and that reading is the 21.20 km above. A surface route between the same two portals would put the trip at 25.50 km and would clear the gate. Nothing in this bundle tells me which of the two happened, so the 15.22% is a product of the missing data, not a finding that the driver stayed on the optimal corridor.

Corroboration. POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing a deviation on an impaired trace without one of four independent sources, and none is present. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00110, impaired, weight 0.6, issue TRUNCATED_LOG) has only 'going KPE ah boss' and 'ok' and no admission - the KPE is the optimal corridor itself - and it stops at 18:26:14, 2186 s before the trip ended. The fare breakdown's erp_gantries is null, so no charged gantry places the car off-corridor. The driver's statement confirms the KPE, again the optimal corridor, and admits no diversion. The trip record's 21.2 km is a copy of the impaired trace, as its own admissibility note concedes. So nothing independent carries the distance fact.

The result. POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) require ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists: the absence of proof is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-01's default of NO_ACTION does not apply, because the reading that fails the gate is itself an artefact of the gap. Escalation is terminal: no amount is refunded, no amount is collected, and the SGD 10.00 stays held.

Confidence. The deciding distance fact is carried by EV-GPS-00110 alone at weight 0.39; the trip record copies it and the fare ledger is not independent, so nothing raises the cap under POL-GEN-02(2). Confidence is 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, which independently trips POL-RD-10(1).

What would resolve it. An ERP gantry itemisation for this trip (gantry name, coordinates and entry time) showing whether the car crossed gantries the KPE/ECP optimal route does not use; or a GPS export with fixes inside the 18:35-18:42 tunnel stretch; or a driver admission of the route actually driven. Under POL-GEN-04 an appeal may add exactly this kind of record-type evidence.

The driver's points. Your point that the measured excess (2.8 km, 15.22%) fails the POL-RD-01 gate is correct as far as it goes, but it cannot be turned into NO_ACTION: the measurement is taken on an impaired trace, and POL-RD-07(iii) says the outcome is ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION. Your points that the trip record is not an independent source, that the billed distance is not corroboration, that the rider has shown no independent source, that the chat is consistent with the optimal corridor, and that 15.22% is not a material deviation (below 50% and 8.0 km) are all accepted. Your point on ERP is accepted: there are no gantry lines at all, and the SGD 3.00 matches the trip record's own optimal-route ERP of 3.00, so no billing-integrity refund arises and no POL-RD-09(4) referral is made. Your observation that the impaired-trace branch produces ESCALATE is also accepted. No POL-RD-06(c) referral is made: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 744, so no pattern exists.

The rider's points. Your points that the trace is impaired for policy (428 s gap, weight 0.39), that the chat supplies no corroboration, that the fare ledger cannot carry the point (erp_gantries null; the charged distance is a copy of the trace), and that the trip record is not an independent source are all accepted. Your point that no extra corroboration burden attaches under POL-RD-08 is also accepted: deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and the profile fields are context only under POL-GEN-01.

Precedent. Earlier cases on these clauses ended PARTIAL_REFUND; what separates this one is that the only distance measurement is an impaired GPS trace with no POL-RD-07(ii) independent source, so no refund can be computed and POL-RD-10(3) applies instead.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
